name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 7 visits over 65 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2025-07-03, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.56 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
